title: fix(plugin-charts): a `yAxis` entry after the second carries a note naming it (objectui#10691)
body:
Fixes #10691
Clause-②: no

A `yAxis` entry after the second now carries a visible note naming it. The accepted count, the schema, the exports and every published prop stay as they are.

## What changed

`@objectstack/spec` declares `ChartConfig.yAxis` as an uncapped list, so a third entry validates. A cartesian chart draws at most two value axes, one per slot. Such an entry drew no axis and no note. The ruling on the card (triage comment `5837770949`): say so, don't narrow.

- **One answer, in `placeYAxes`** (`packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts`). The placement gains `undrawn`, which lists every entry after the second in index order. Each item carries `boundTo`, the slot a series derived from that entry binds to. That slot is `'right'`, the same binding the normalizer already gave such a series, so no binding moves. `YAxisUndrawnNote` is a new sibling of `YAxisPositionNote` and has the same export surface: the module exports it and the package index does not. The normalizer's derived-series binding now reads its slot from the placement (`slotOf`, then `undrawn`). The local `?? 'right'` fallback is gone, so the binding and the note come from one call.
- **The note** (`packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`, `yAxisUndrawnNotes`). Each undrawn entry gets one `p role="note" data-chart-note="y-axis-undrawn"`. It joins the same `ChartFootnote` footnote as the `y-axis-position` notes and comes after them. It uses their classes and their hard-coded English wording, since that channel uses no i18n keys. On a bar chart it reads: "`yAxis[2]` is not drawn — this chart draws at most two value axes, one on each side. When the chart declares neither `series` nor `categories`, its field `units` is plotted against the axis on the right, `yAxis[1]`." On `horizontal-bar` the sides read "at the bottom" and "at the top".
  - The binding sentence is conditional because a chart with authored `series` derives no series from the entry, and the renderer cannot tell the two cases apart.
  - The entry named in that sentence is the one `placeYAxes` drew in the slot. It is `yAxis[0]` when the first entry sits on the right.
  - An entry with no `field` derives no series, so its note has only the first sentence.
- **Docs.** The `Axis options` intro in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx` gains one sentence stating the two-axis limit and the note.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/10691-third-yaxis-note.md`, `'@object-ui/plugin-charts': patch`. Its prose and the docs sentence make a contract review owed; both cite objectui#10691.

This change does not narrow the count, add a zod or TS mirror, refuse the chart, add a published prop, edit `ObjectChart.tsx`, or add a date-formatting locale read.

## The dispatch's hypotheses, measured

Instrument: a throwaway jsdom probe through `ChartRenderer`, run at the base `f905090` and again at the head, then deleted. The rows are `revenue` 10..20, `cost` 3..5 and `units` 50..90. The three entries are `revenue`, `cost`, and `units` titled `third` with `min: 0` and `max: 1000`.

- **H1, confirmed.** At the base, bar drew 9 bar rectangles, with axis titles `Revenue` and `Cost` only and 0 notes. Line, area, combo and horizontal-bar drew 0 notes each. The base blobs of both implementation files are PR objectui#10686's head blobs (`4356fc08`, `ab7945cb`).
- **H2, confirmed: the right-hand slot.** The normalizer derives `dataKey: 'units', label: 'third', yAxis: 'right'`. On every family the right-hand axis ticks run 0 to 100, shared by `cost` and `units`, and the entry's own 0..1000 domain is not drawn. On horizontal-bar the same series is on the top axis. The note names that slot and the entry drawn in it. The render pins check the note's claim against the ticks.
- **H3, confirmed.** The note is built from `placeYAxes`'s placement, through a sibling note type at the module-level export surface only.
- **H4, confirmed.** 14 DOM dumps are byte-identical between base and head:
  - pie, donut, funnel, radar and scatter with three entries;
  - bar with no entry and with one or two entries;
  - a two-entry bar with a position conflict, and one with `top`;
  - line, area, combo and horizontal-bar with two entries.
  For the five three-entry charts, the normalizer's `series` and every tick label are identical between base and head. The note is the only addition.

## Pin: `packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.yAxisUndrawn-10691.test.tsx` (18 tests, through `ChartRenderer`)

- Three entries on bar, line, area, combo and horizontal-bar: exactly one `y-axis-undrawn` note, naming `yAxis[2]`, `units` and the axis (on the right, `yAxis[1]`; at the top on horizontal-bar). The same rows check that axis's ticks cover 90 and stay under 1000.
- Four entries: two notes, `yAxis[2]` then `yAxis[3]`.
- `[right, left, units]`: the note names `yAxis[0]`.
- `[left, left, units]`: the `y-axis-position` note is kept beside the new one.
- Authored `series`: the note still names `yAxis[2]`.
- Controls: two entries on the five families carry no note. A two-entry conflict carries exactly its `y-axis-position` note. Pie with three entries carries no note.
- Placement pins: `undrawn` lists indices 2 and 3 for four entries, and the derived series at each index binds to its `boundTo`. `undrawn` is empty for 0, 1 or 2 entries.

Readings:

- Head `7117670`: `Tests  18 passed (18)`, exit 0.
- Base swap from the committed state: the two implementation files were replaced with the base blobs `4356fc08` and `ab7945cb`, then restored to the HEAD blobs `b3ad9f35` and `9ce23ae5`, with `git diff HEAD` empty and the status clean. Result: `Tests  11 failed | 7 passed (18)`, exit 1. The 7 green are exactly the render controls. Every render failure is the zero-note assertion.
- Ablation (`ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor hit x1, blob `9ce23ae5` to `eb06e206`, restored to `9ce23ae5` with `git diff HEAD` empty). Flipping `boundTo` to `'left'` gave `Tests  6 failed | 12 passed (18)`, exit 1. The six rows that state a side went red. The pin tying the normalizer's binding to `undrawn` stayed green, because both read the same answer.

  - The resolved config's `parserOptions` is empty, so no type-aware linting runs and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

- `origin/main` (`383a34f52`) was merged before opening. It brought 48 files and none of them is in `plugin-charts`. `packages/types` moved, so the suite and type-check were re-run at the merged head.
- The open-PR file lists were re-read before opening. None touches this diff's files: PR objectui#8941 touches only `packages/plugin-charts/package.json`, and the release PR has no file under `src/` or `content/docs/`.
- CI: not awaited.

## Acceptance notes

- NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` exit 2 (prerequisite: a scoped 34-package build). The docs edit is one prose sentence with no fenced block.
- NOT MEASURED: a real-browser render. The note is read from the jsdom DOM.
- `scatter` is unchanged on purpose: it draws one y axis, and the renderer places only its first entry. A scatter entry after the first therefore still draws no axis and no note when `series` is authored (probe: three entries with one authored series, 0 notes). This is outside the card, which covers entries past the second on two-axis charts. It is reported to the seat, not addressed here.
- The docs sentence "one entry per value axis, and a second entry declares the right-hand axis" is kept. It is true for the default case, and the new sentence beside it states the limit.
